## Janaury 2024

### 20240131 Wenesday

At work in ATO office. Long time no post, jotting notes while waiting for code.

Got home from 6 weeks in Tassie on Saturday afternoon. Huge break.

Over the holiday, James did so many amazingly exciting things. Partial list:

*   Kyaking with Daddy and Poppy
    +   Went to the far end of sisters beach and touched the rock with our paddle. Amazaed that James 
        sat still for 45 minutes. 
*   Child's quad motorbike ride at Jono's.
    +   James had ride on his own. Did ok as long as he kept looking forward. 
    +   James asked if we could 'come back tomorrow'. 
*   Helicopter Ride
    +   Poppy organised with his friend Rodney to give us a helicopter ride from Sisters beach. 
    +   Mummy did not want to come, so just Daddy and James went with Poppy. 
    +   Daddy's first helicopter ride. 
    +   Flew to Woolnorth then turned down the west coast for a little way before turning back. 
*   Tractor Rides
    +   Granny and Pa both gave out generous amounts of tractor rides
*   Rope swing at creek

James also had great time playing with Nathaniel, Evie and Elijah. Kids generally got on very well. 
James behavior was unusually difficult around bed times we think due to combinations of tiredness, 
excitement and absence of routine. Despite difficult periods, still lovely most of the time.

Everyone though Theo's development over the holiday was amazing. He had already been doing great with
his words but just went crazy over the holiday. Over the period grasped names for all grandparents, and 
paddy. Learnt cows and sheep and associated noises. Loved taking John from one side of the paddock to 
the other to find the animals.

Began to demonstrate strong awarness of surrounds and devloped associations with what 'should be there'.

For example, hoing out of the old house in the morning, would point to the road and say 'cows'. When
arriving at Nanny and Poppy's crown st house would say 'boats', 'nanny', 'poppy'. 

On one trip to the creek, Granny and Pa met us there. The next time we went, as walking toward the creek, 
he pointed to where they had been last time and said 'granny', 'pa'. 

When we returned to Sister's beach for our stay with the Mollisons, kept looking around for Nanny and Poppy, 
certain they should be there. 

Upon returning to Queanbeyan, very keen to look at picture of grandparents on the wall and practice their 
names. 

## February 2024

### 20240229 Thursday


Today: up around 7,  breakfast, nappy, bath, out of the house before 830, at BigW jus before opening 
(quick ride in Peppa Pig van to kill 5 minutes). Meat from Aldi (Theo riding in main part of trolley as 
wont stay put in seat next to James; James behving perfectly, holding foxy). 

Off to Seafood shop, stop at corner store to get ice, home by 1010, get into swimmers and Off to 
Queanbeyan pool. James enjoys kickboard race with another little girl and refereed by her grandmother. 

Theo loves jumipng into pool. Where as James instinct was to stick to me in the pool at this age Theo 
tries to get away. No concern at all and extremely trusting that I will be there to get him out of trouble.

Lots of smiles and hellos from other people. 

Quick trip to Maccers straigh after the pool (racing to get food for Theo before he gos to sleep).

After eating, theo asleep in 2 minutes of driving. 

Home to have first sleep in new bed (I think).

James watches TV for a bit, then starts excavation dig, happily plays wth the for couple oh hours.

Theo wakes up, Daddy continues tryign to prep for dinner, get washing away etc. 

Gnocchi bolegnese for dinner, both kids eat well. 

Bath, then drive. James asleep, Theo asleep but doesnt stick. 

Watch Nivalny documentaty with Daddy and Mummy.
